evidence_kind: Original DLL/PDB bounded static evidence; no original execution or Android gameplay evidence.

action.names: Names when nonnil, otherwise Name; LuaTableExtensions string List. Ordered requested names; no invented default weapon.
action.destination_ids: DestinationIds when nonnil, otherwise DestinationId; LuaTableExtensions IntList. Only these exact destination field spellings.
action.destination_names: DestinationNames when nonnil, otherwise DestinationName; string List. These select GroupManager identities/membership, not a scan of source data-definition names.
action.precedence: Plural presence suppresses singular even when plural table is empty. Helpers reuse nonempty cached lists in the individual ScriptArgs.
action.selection: Resolve runtime IDs through World active-ID map +0x398 and names through GroupManager/GetIndex/world membership +0x320; union into pointer hash set, deduplicate. Missing selections contribute nothing; all empty means empty target set. Hash iteration does not establish stable target order.
action.ordering: Resolve target set once, then Names once, loop names outside targets. For each name request package first if enabled; then loop selected target set.
action.type_gate: Live nonnull Thing whose flags satisfy ((~flags)&0x221)==0; metadata proxy is not an active Unit.

load_packages.true_behavior: GameAssetManager::LoadPackageAsync(requested weapon name,false,nullptr), once per name before target/type/duplicate checks. No unit-package-name rewrite. It synchronously invokes LoadManifest(name,false), enqueues work, returns immediately.

action.equip: Selected Unit arsenal+0x428; HasWeapon(name) skips duplicates. Weapon::Create(name,arsenal.pOwner) absent data/null returns skip. AddWeapon(instance,false). If instance WeaponData+0x8bc ReloadOnEquip true, call reload then cooldown(-1).
action.callbacks: No direct Script::Run/notify/OnPackageLoaded/Lua callback call in complete action body; downstream delegated weapon/arsenal behavior is separate.
action.delay: Original Void action registration centrally admits Delay; immediate equip handler does not repeat delay admission.

observations.claim: Requested names and target groups are distinct selector roles.
Package admission precedes checking targets and duplicates.
No fabricated return value; native return is Void.

unknowns: Malformed input numeric/string list conversion needs exact List/IntList branch review when reconstructing beyond ordinary original inputs.
Native pointer hash target order is not portable map iteration order.
Weapon runtime needs delegated initialization and update/fire contracts independently.
